title: Deployment: Move Configuration and Content Between Sites | Orchard Core
description:
A site is often built in one place and run in another. Repeating every change by hand takes time, and a forgotten setting makes the two sites differ.

The Deployment module collects what to move in a deployment plan, runs the plan to produce a package, and imports the package on another Orchard Core site. This video follows one setting from a source site to a staging site.

In this video:
• Why deployment: the work you repeat by hand
• Find the module: the Features page and the Tools menu
• Build and run a plan: steps, targets, and the package download
• Import the package: Package Import on the staging site
• Permissions: who can plan, export, and import
